composition.serve_who: Drawing GMMS 108’-114a is the +24 V control, actuation and indication sheet for the main bilge pump and five electrically actuated bilge-valve channels. The top row is explicitly labelled MAIN BILGE PUMP; the repeated centre rows are labelled BILGE VALVE and terminate at compartment bilge switches; the lower-right boxed regions are explicitly MAIN PANEL and MAIN PANEL PC CARD. Accordingly, pump-specific loops attach to the main-pump node, valve actuation/position loops attach to the bilge-valves node, and the common service-battery feeder, terminal/relay architecture, main-panel connectors and ONYX cross-references remain infrastructure/interface facts.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Main Bilge Pump — Gianneschi ACB 431 B
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The upper sheet region explicitly names the motor load MAIN BILGE PUMP, while the lower MAIN PANEL row names S13 as BILGE PUMP SW. This is the engineer-confirmed BILGE PUMP mapping and does not include the separate fire pump.

functions.label: Run and stop the main bilge pump from local, main-panel or ONYX control
functions.what_it_does: Supplies the main bilge-pump motor and closes its solenoid contactor when any drawn/established run-command path is selected; releasing all run commands opens the control loop and stops the motor.

flow_scenarios.path: +24 V service-battery source → feeder protection → F3 60 A pump fuse → SW8 and normally open solenoid main contact → open contact blocks power to MAIN BILGE PUMP motor; motor return is shown to the return/chassis symbol.

+24 V control supply → local pump switch through the drawn pump-control terminal group → solenoid contactor coil; established loop closure is at terminals 13/14, with T/S control conductors 12/14/15 → solenoid main contact closes → +24 V service-battery source → F2 200 A feeder fuse → F3 60 A → SW8 → closed solenoid contact → MAIN BILGE PUMP motor → shown motor return.

MAIN PANEL S13 BILGE PUMP SW → Plug C pins 6/7 and the drawn pump-control conductors → T/S control loop, with established closure at terminals 13/14 and control conductors 12/14/15 → solenoid contactor coil → contact closes → +24 V service-battery source → F2 200 A → F3 60 A → SW8 → MAIN BILGE PUMP motor → shown return; the lamp branch at Plug C pin 6 provides panel run indication.

ONYX remote command → drawn off-sheet ONYX interface/control conductor → same established T/S pump-control loop, closing the solenoid coil circuit at terminals 13/14 → contact closes → +24 V service-battery source → F2 200 A → F3 60 A → SW8 → MAIN BILGE PUMP motor → shown return.

key_components: load protection — pump fuse F3, 60 A
main feeder protection — F2, 200 A, upstream shared service-battery feeder
isolation/manual series switch — SW8
motor switching — solenoid-operated contact/contactor SO6
local command — LOCAL PUMP SW
remote command — main-panel switch S13 through Plug C pins 6/7
remote command interface — drawn continuation to ONYX
run indication — lamp branch in the S13 circuit
functions.dry_data: 24 V DC motor branch; solenoid-contactor actuation; sheet protection F3 60 A with upstream shared F2 200 A; local + main-panel + ONYX command capability.
functions.sheet_region: Top horizontal motor circuit (approximately upper 15% of sheet), plus S13/Plug C in the lower-right MAIN PANEL region and the central/off-sheet ONYX continuation.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Bilge Valves — five Burkert electric DN050 ball-valve assemblies
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The five repeated centre groups each show OPEN/CLOSE position contacts, a motor-operated BILGE VALVE, a compartment bilge switch endpoint and a corresponding relay/terminal channel. Established identity confirms five Burkert electric rotary actuators on DN050 two-way ball valves.

functions.label: Open or close the selected bilge suction valve
functions.what_it_does: Operates one of five motorised ball valves so the bilge system can select the lazarette, aft, engine-room, forward or sail-locker bilge branch; each channel is driven through its own relay and replaceable fused terminal.

flow_scenarios.path: +24 V BILGE VALVES supply remains available through Q13 10 A, but the selected channel relay is not commanded → neither actuator direction is energised → valve remains at its last position; its OPEN/CLOSE limit contacts independently report actual position.

Main-panel S20 LAZARETTE BILGE via Plug C pin 1, or the drawn remote channel interface at XA40:14/XA40:12 → Re1 control → replaceable fused terminal T/S B:8 → T/S C channel terminals 7–15 → lazarette-associated bilge-valve actuator direction lead → actuator motor → common return; OPEN/CLOSE contacts return through T/S C 7/8 and Plug D pins 1/2 to the PC-card indicators. The field bilge-switch wiring includes both PORT LAZARETTE BILGE and STBD LAZARETTE BILGE on this channel group.

Main-panel S21 AFT BILGE via Plug C pin 2, or drawn remote interface XA40:16 → Re2 control → replaceable fused terminal T/S B:9 → T/S C terminals 16–23 → aft-associated bilge-valve actuator direction lead → actuator motor → common return; OPEN/CLOSE contacts return through T/S C 16/17 and Plug D pins 3/4 to the PC-card indicators.

Main-panel S22 ENG. ROOM BILGE via Plug C pin 3, or drawn remote interface XA10:06 → Re3 control → replaceable fused terminal T/S B:10 → T/S C terminals 24–31 → engine-room bilge-valve actuator direction lead → actuator motor → common return; OPEN/CLOSE contacts return through T/S C 24/25 and Plug D pins 5/6 to the PC-card indicators.

Main-panel S23 FWD BILGE via Plug C pin 4, or drawn remote interface XA10:04 → Re4 control → replaceable fused terminal T/S B:11 → T/S C terminals 32–39 → forward bilge-valve actuator direction lead → actuator motor → common return; OPEN/CLOSE contacts return through T/S C 32/33 and Plug D pins 7/8 to the PC-card indicators.

Main-panel S24 SAIL LOCKER via Plug C pin 5, or drawn remote interface XA10:02 → Re5 control → replaceable fused terminal T/S B:12 → T/S C terminals 40–47 → sail-locker bilge-valve actuator direction lead → actuator motor → common return; OPEN/CLOSE contacts return through T/S C 40/41 and Plug D pins 9/10 to the PC-card indicators.

key_components: branch overcurrent protection — Q13, 10 A, labelled BILGE VALVES
direction/control relays — Re1 through Re5, one per active valve channel
replaceable fused terminals — T/S B:8, :9, :10, :11 and :12, exact channel protection and primary troubleshooting points
position sensors — paired OPEN and CLOSE actuator limit contacts for each valve
actuators — five motorised Burkert rotary actuators on DN050 two-way ball valves
operator controls — main-panel switches S20–S24 through Plug C pins 1–5
field demand inputs — port/stbd lazarette, aft, engine-room, forward and sail-locker BILGE SW endpoints
remote interfaces — XA40:14/:12/:16 and XA10:06/:04/:02 as drawn into the corresponding relay circuits
functions.dry_data: Five 24 V DC electrically actuated channels; Burkert rotary actuators on DN050 two-way ball valves; common branch protected by Q13 10 A; individual replaceable fused terminals T/S B:8–12.
functions.sheet_region: Repeated valve circuits across the middle of the sheet: relay bank Re1–Re5 at left-centre, T/S C terminals 7–47 centrally, and five actuator/field-switch groups at right-centre.

functions.label: Display each valve’s open/closed position and raise the common bilge alarm indication
functions.what_it_does: Returns each actuator’s OPEN and CLOSED limit state to the main-panel PC card, lights the corresponding position lamp, and diode-combines the five open-state lines for the drawn pedestal alarm/mute interface.

flow_scenarios.state: Valve between limits / no confirmed state
flow_scenarios.path: Neither OPEN nor CLOSED limit contact made → associated T/S C status conductors → Plug D channel pair → neither corresponding main-panel position input is asserted; no inferred valve position is permitted.

Selected valve OPEN limit contact → its T/S C status pair → Plug D odd-numbered input (lazarette 1, aft 3, engine room 5, forward 7, sail locker 9) → matching MAIN PANEL PC CARD open lamp against the card’s +24 V lamp common; the five odd-numbered open lines also feed the drawn diode network → Plug D line 11/common alarm route → Plug C/AUX plug alarm interface → pedestal ALARM MOD and mute circuit.

Selected valve CLOSED limit contact → its T/S C status pair → Plug D even-numbered input (lazarette 2, aft 4, engine room 6, forward 8, sail locker 10) → matching MAIN PANEL PC CARD closed lamp against the card’s +24 V lamp common.

Open-state diode-combined alarm signal → Plug D line 11 and main-panel auxiliary interface → Plug C pins 8–11 / AUX PLUG ON PC BOARD pins 1–4 → pedestal ALARM MOD; operation of the drawn mute contact between Plug C pin 11 and common pin 12 silences/acknowledges the audible branch while the position indication remains driven by the limit-contact path.

key_components: position sensing — ten actuator limit contacts, OPEN and CLOSED for five valves
visual indication — ten main-panel PC-card lamps, open/closed per channel
alarm isolation/OR logic — five diodes combining open-state lines 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 onto line 11
audible/acknowledge interface — pedestal ALARM MOD, alarm lamp and mute contact
connectors — Plug D pins 1–11 and Plug C pins 8–12 / four-pin auxiliary PC-board plug
indicator supply — PC-card +24 V lamp common
functions.dry_data: Main-panel PC-card indication: 5 × OPEN plus 5 × CLOSED lamps; diode-combined common open-state alarm; pedestal alarm/mute interface on Plug C/AUX plug.
functions.sheet_region: Lower-right dotted MAIN PANEL PC CARD box with Plug D, plus the MAIN PANEL Plug C and PEDESTAL ALARM + MUTE region immediately above.

infrastructure.system_name: +24 V DC service-battery distribution serving this bilge sheet
facts: The drawn source is labelled +24V SERVICE BAT.
Shared incoming protection is F2 200 A before the vertical distribution conductor.
The drawn conductor branches separately to the main-pump fuse F3 60 A and to the BILGE VALVES breaker Q13 10 A; shared voltage does not merge the pump and valve systems.
F2 and the common supply topology are infrastructure; F3 and Q13 remain load-specific protection in their respective equipment loops.

infrastructure.system_name: Vessel Control Panel / MAIN PANEL bilge control and indication infrastructure
facts: The sheet explicitly boxes MAIN PANEL and MAIN PANEL PC CARD regions.

Plug C is a 12-pin control/alarm connector: pins 1–5 serve S20–S24 valve selectors, pins 6/7 serve pump indication/control S13, pins 8–11 interface the alarm module through the four-pin auxiliary PC-board plug, and pin 12 is the shown switch/alarm common.
Plug D carries five OPEN/CLOSED position pairs on pins 1–10; pin 11 is the diode-combined open-state alarm node; pin 12 has no further internal connection drawn on this sheet.
T/S C terminals 7–50, the repeated relay bank and shared internal commons are panel wiring infrastructure; T/S B:8–13 are replaceable fused terminals, not ordinary terminals.
Re6 through fused terminal T/S B:13 is shown at the bottom of the relay bank, but its adjacent conductor/position is marked not used and no sixth valve actuator is drawn.
A conductor is explicitly continued off-sheet 'to ONYX'.
XA40:14/:12/:16, XA10:06/:04/:02 and XA11:32 are drawn cross-reference/interface tags in the relay/control wiring; only the links physically drawn on this sheet are retained.
The established main-pump loop confirms ONYX as an alternative remote pump-run command source.
The exact ONYX I/O point semantics beyond the drawn relay destinations are off-sheet and are not inferred from proximity.

discarded_as_clutter: Title-block company, project, customer, date and copyright text
Duplicate terminal-side conductor numerals that only restate terminal-strip pin numbering
Extraction placeholders such as '<UNKNOWN> switch' where the image resolves the device as the pedestal mute contact or a normal drawn switch symbol
Repeated open/closed lamp rows after composing them as one five-channel indication function
Re6 adjacent 'not used' position as an active valve function; retained only as an infrastructure fact
Protective-earth/enclosure-boundary symbol as a separate equipment item
Drawing cross-reference arrows treated as metadata where their off-sheet destination is not shown
uncertainties: The sheet reads the pump branch fuse as F3 60 A, while an established distribution-sheet fact records F7 60 A for the main bilge pump. Both source-specific identifiers are retained; whether F3 is a local downstream fuse or a drafting/renumbering difference requires cross-sheet or onboard verification.
The exact upstream panel/enclosure containing F2, F3 and Q13 is not named on this sheet; it is therefore recorded only as +24 V service-battery/DC-distribution infrastructure.

For each motorised valve, the drawing clearly shows OPEN and CLOSE command/limit conductors but does not label actuator polarity or which motor terminal is the open versus close drive; no polarity has been guessed.

The first field group contains separate PORT LAZARETTE BILGE and STBD LAZARETTE BILGE switches around one repeated actuator channel. The exact hydraulic branch arrangement is not shown on this electrical sheet, so the composition does not invent separate valves or fluid connections.

The repeated actuator text appears as BILGE VALVE / ENG. ROOM BILGE in several rows despite the associated compartment labels AFT, ENG. ROOM, FWD and SAIL LOCKER. Channel identity is taken from the unambiguous main-panel/field labels; the exact physical valve naming should be checked against the bilge piping schematic.

The XA-style interface lines reach relay/control wiring, but their exact ONYX signal names, active polarity and whether every point is command, enable or feedback are defined off-sheet; only their channel destinations are stated.
Plug D pin 12 has no further internal connection drawn, and XA11:32/Re6 does not reach a sixth actuator on this sheet; no function is assigned beyond the shown unused/spare wiring.

The precise electrical behavior of the pedestal mute contact—momentary silence versus latched acknowledge—is not stated; the scenario records only that it acts in the drawn alarm branch without suppressing valve-position indication.
